tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: When it comes to taking a vacation, do you have a preference for traveling during the winter months or the summer season?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说到度假，你更喜欢在冬季出行还是夏季出行？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: What kind of activities do you usually enjoy while on holiday? For instance, do you prefer relaxing on a beach, or do you enjoy leisurely exploring local streets and landmarks?
tasks.analysis: 中文：度假时你通常喜欢做什么样的活动？比如说，你是更喜欢在海滩上放松，还是喜欢悠闲地逛逛当地的街道和地标？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: In terms of planning your time off, would you rather take frequent short trips throughout the year, or go on one extended vacation that lasts a much longer period?
tasks.analysis: 中文：在安排休假时间方面，你宁愿全年频繁地进行短途旅行，还是更喜欢进行一次持续时间长得多的大长假？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Do you prefer to independently plan the itinerary with your friends, or would you rather join an organized tour group managed by a travel agency?
tasks.analysis: 中文：你更喜欢和朋友一起独立规划行程，还是更愿意参加由旅行社组织的跟团游？
tasks.title: Interview
